notes.title: New Release - Pirates of Black Cove
notes.content:
Pirates of Black Cove is now available on Steam!

Start out as a humble pirate and earn fame and notoriety to become a recognized pirate captain. This is your chance to become the pirate king and conquer the Caribbean!

Purchase before August 9th at 10AM Pacific Time and receive Woody Two-Legs: Attack of the Zombie Pirates for Free!
